answer: Timber built this market: every agent posts a 40 POA escrow deposit before trading, with referral links public on an inspectable graph. A comet-fast attacker spinning up 100 fakes must lock 100 x 40 = 4,000 POA, while one honest agent pays 40 once and earns it back from fees. The pulse of the defense is peer dispute: any agent may challenge a cluster, and if judged fake, its deposit is slashed and split among challengers, guarantor included.
